## What this site is

Satellite to Decision is for people who want to use satellite data in business decisions. Our readers include consultants who are new to satellite data, local government and infrastructure managers, surveying and civil engineering consultants, and people working in agriculture.

We cover not only what is possible, but also how far today's technology reaches, what you can decide once it is part of your operations, and where the cost falls.

Articles are written in Japanese. This page and the entry pages of each series are available in English.

## Two certifications

On the [Certifications](cert.qmd) page we run two certifications: **{{< var cert.business_en >}}** (for those who use and commission satellite data) and **{{< var cert.analysis_en >}}** (for those who run analyses themselves). Both test whether you can make the call in a given situation. Syllabus, levels, format and sample questions are on that page.

## Our position

We write independently of any satellite operator or analytics company.

- We do not recommend specific companies or services. We set out criteria for choosing
- We give what cannot be done the same weight as what can
- When we mention a company, we write only publicly announced facts

## Supervision

The site is supervised by five people who have worked at space agencies around the world, including JAXA and ISRO.

They take part as individuals. This does not represent the official view or involvement of any agency.

## How articles are produced

We use AI to draft the text. Published articles have had their sources and unverified points checked by a person.

- Figures, specifications, regulations and cases come with sources. We give priority to official material from government bodies, research institutes, academic societies and companies
- Statements that could not be verified are marked and explained at the end of the article
- Figures are produced by this site

## Figures and costs

- Market sizes are shown with their source, scope and year. Where estimates differ between research firms, we show the range
- Costs are limited to published amounts (public budgets, official price lists, announced contract values), with source and conditions
- Statements beginning with 「仮定：」 (assumption) are rough estimates based on premises set by this site
- We distinguish between pilot and full operation. The classification is our own reading of public material and may differ from that of the parties involved

## Corporate plans

Corporate plans are available. If you are considering use across a company or department, please get in touch.

We also offer a preparation course for the Satellite Data Business Kentei (サテライトデータビジネス検定), a Japanese certification exam. The course is not an official offering of the exam organiser.
